measurement_1_turn_zero_predecessor_repl.scope: task and semantic times full, answer-boundary, and non-boundary routes times native and FP32 readouts
measurement_1_turn_zero_predecessor_repl.interpretation: Turn 0 exactly re-enters the sealed readout-precision assay before any generated answer is appended.

measurement_2_semantic_intact_twin_traje.interpretation: Neither fixed nor free history produces an intact-to-twin change on any affected semantic answer. Small fixed-history margins do not grow monotonically or preserve donor direction across turns.

measurement_3_delayed_divergence_audit.interpretation: A small same-prefix score difference can cross a sampled threshold on an unaffected turn and its answer can then amplify later divergence. This is real trajectory feedback, but it is not donor-directed semantic accumulation.

measurement_4_generic_history_feedback_c.interpretation: Self-generated history strongly changes later choices even without workspace memory. Free-history divergence is therefore a generic autoregressive sensitivity control, not semantic evidence by itself.

measurement_5_task_checkpoint_threshold_.interpretation: A few matched samples cross discrete thresholds in the task checkpoint, but the fixed native crossings are not consistently donor-directed and vanish in FP32. They do not transfer to the semantic checkpoint.

measurement_6_behavior_reference.interpretation: The inline base remains the strongest bounded reference. Workspace routes do not recover twin-context affected answers and degrade sharply when their own sampled choices are fed back.

supported: The precision assay and the first multi-turn state join exactly at turn 0.
Small score changes can cross a sampling threshold on a later turn and the resulting answer history can produce much larger downstream differences.
Fixed and free histories are mechanically separated, exposing generic autoregressive feedback as a large control effect.
not_supported: Donor-directed temporal accumulation in the semantic checkpoint: affected intact-to-twin choices never change.
A semantic full-route trajectory bifurcation: all 16 fixed and all 16 free pairs remain identical under both heads.
Specificity of the two delayed semantic divergences, because they begin on an unaffected question and generic base histories diverge frequently.
Natural free-form chat quality, KV-cache-specific accumulation, semantic memory, generalization, or promotion.
overall_conclusion.smallest_next_gate: Do not extend the conversation horizon yet. First train or calibrate an architecture-owned, precision-aware comparison bridge against donor-directed margin with unaffected and unrelated controls, then rerun this identical four-turn assay. Longer free-history runs would currently amplify generic answer-history errors faster than semantic signal.
